study.question: Does preserving the complete strongest grouped history representation and appending field retrieval exceed both frozen source bests, and does the added target query help beyond matched history-only retrieval?
study.hypothesis: Observed: baseline-static/pooled/din AUCs are 0.6050036/0.6102261/0.6133620; grouped paired_match reaches 0.6191087654 and target_separate reaches 0.6153351064. These are separate single-seed trajectories, not evidence of complementary mechanisms. Source inspection shows paired_match has no executed event scorer: within each exact-match group it keeps an embedding mean and coarse action/age contingency cells. Histories with the same means and counts can differ in target-relevant embedding distributions. A parallel target-conditioned readout may recover distinctions while retaining all incumbent statistics. Main alternative is redundancy with already target-conditioned groups, or improvement from extra active capacity rather than target conditioning. The 2x2 replacement controls test that uncertainty.

nearest_work.difference: All five representation/count/histogram methods and the complete original input block are retained. Append one d-vector and activate its previously dormant scorer. This is a new local compatibility experiment, not a new pooling or contingency invention.

Reuse field queries, shared relation scorer, separate/consensus value reads and norm matching. Add that summary to paired_match rather than replacing its representation or using the source small classifier; add explicit zero-length guard.

Target-dependent weighted historical readout is established prior work. DIN explicitly abandons softmax to preserve interest intensity; this local implementation inherits normalized softmax and mean-norm matching from target_separate and retains count channels. No exact DIN reproduction or novelty priority claim.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:dmr; author README at 2c6e76804281954a3c969010a31712cd5054aca9; primary lines 1-8
nearest_work.difference: The author confirms category/brand/type histories without item identity. We do not invent history item IDs, matching pretraining, or claim full DMR reproduction; publisher full text is unavailable in the granted source.

Its attention-generated probes, field-sequence refinement and multiview pipeline are not implemented. We test the simpler inherited ad versus history query replacement; source pCVR/row-group split/auxiliary delay labels and optimizers are not transferable evidence.

No FM highway, deep bus exchange or mutual distillation is implemented. Its tiny-mode finding that pooling partly overlaps cross-attention and mixed fusion AUC/logloss motivates treating redundancy as a live alternative, not assuming attention helps.

study.proposed_difference: Concatenate the entire paired_match feature vector with one 16-dimensional event retrieval summary before the existing [128,64] classifier. Cross target_query true/false with separate_reads true/false in four standalone identical-allocation modules. All cells compute both separate and consensus summaries using the same field scores. Appending d inputs adds exactly d*128=2048 allocated weights (17,147,171 total; 68,483 dense given the supplied meta), and activates the inherited 4,226 scorer parameters, a 6,274 active-weight increment relative to paired_match. Context controls match both active and allocated capacity. No causal complementarity, efficiency or global novelty claim before outcomes.
predictions: Utility prediction: hybrid_target_separate exceeds 0.6191087654101018 and 0.6153351063827704 on full validation under seed 42; failure leaves incremental utility unsupported.
Conditioning prediction: target-minus-context AUC is positive with separate reads; examine the joint-read effect and interaction rather than assume additivity.
Readout prediction: separate-minus-joint may help target queries if category and brand evidence differ; its context counterpart tests whether the effect needs the target.

Structural checks: original means/counts/histograms remain unchanged as functions of inputs/parameters; appended summary matches masked-mean history norm, vanishes for empty history and is insensitive to masked positions.

Host exploratory slices use existing frozen bins and report counts: history length (empty,1-16,17-64,>64), existing hour/action/frequency/category-match groups. Missing-target-brand retrieval diagnostics are candidate supplied; no new scored slice availability is assumed.

Source-level expressivity check only: two entirely neither-match histories, category embeddings [(1,0),(0,1)] versus [(0.5,0.5),(0.5,0.5)] and identical brands/actions/age cells, give the same original means/counts. For a realizable dot-product relation scorer and target (1,0), norm-matched separate readouts differ by 0.3037113684 in Euclidean distance; context-mean query readouts agree. This deterministic constructed example is not a dataset observation, score, novelty claim or measured mechanism support.
falsifiers: No gain over paired_match in paired repetitions, or gains within seed variation: no supported incremental utility.
Context control matches or exceeds target-conditioned gain: added conditioning unsupported despite possible retrieval/capacity benefit.
Joint read matches separate read: separate field routing unsupported.

Padding dependence, nonfinite logits/gradients/diagnostics, wrong feature width, empty-history nonzero summary, or source hash/schema mismatch invalidates that implementation; retain failure and budget costs.
A gain present only in one seed, a post-hoc slice or one selected epoch cannot establish a general mechanism.
Cost exceeds trial cap or a cheaper source dominates measured AUC/logloss-cost tradeoff: no efficiency advantage.
alternative_explanations: Already target-dependent semantic groups and action/age statistics make field retrieval redundant.
Extra classifier weights and activation of 4,226 dormant scorer parameters improve expressiveness independently of added target query.
Classifier width changes random initialization relative to frozen source references; matched factorial cells share allocation order but source comparisons remain utility comparisons.
Shared embeddings receive new gradients; preserving input feature functions does not preserve trained source representations.
Mean-norm matching controls amplitude but may restrict useful attention intensity, and concatenation may fail to exploit complementary information.
Validation selection, user dependence, limited seed evidence or noisy latency measurements explain small apparent gains.
Source pCVR architectures, static snapshot timing uncertainty and 128-event truncation limit transfer and interpretation.

Authorized agent-memory searches for prior failures/abandoned branches returned no hits; only five supplied successful observations are available. No unseen negative trajectory or disabled personal source was invented.

variants.name: hybrid_target_separate
variants.note: Preserve full paired_match block; append norm-matched field retrieval; target_query=True, separate_reads=True. Same class/allocation/computed reads across four cells. Default optimizer/loss. Syntax/source checks only locally; Torch and all empirical results host-pending. Local validation: Python compile/AST passed; recursive runtime study-schema, protocol/evidence/config/standalone checks passed. All four Model ASTs identical; five ancestor representation methods and four retrieval methods exact; _read differs only by zero-length guard. Forty-five diagnostic keys, numeric imports, no model I/O, no optimizer/loss hooks. Torch unavailable and validate_task.py absent; no forward/backward/training/scoring execution or performance gain claimed. Independent 2D scalar algebra (embedded in d=16 with zero unused coordinates) verified the mean/count collision admits distinct target readouts after norm matching, while the context read is identical; all four read choices also passed permutation, padding, singleton, all-masked, zero-length and degenerate-norm checks. This proves representational possibility for a realizable dot-product setting of the inherited relation scorer, not predictive usefulness or Torch correctness.
